cardDesc: Full-stack analytics system: 3NF schema, ETL pipeline loading 179K+ records, and automated KPI reporting.
label: Data Engineering
title: Database Design for Restaurant Analytics
overview: End-to-end analytics system built on a normalized MySQL schema with automated ETL, KPI reporting, and revenue visualization. Designed for correctness and scale: 9+ CHECK constraints, deduplication logic, and $6.9M revenue reconciliation across 179K+ records.
details: Architected 3NF MySQL schema with full ERD and 9+ CHECK constraints for data integrity
R ETL pipeline with deduplication, validation, and automated reconciliation workflows
Automated KPI reporting and YoY revenue visualization in R Markdown
Stored procedures encapsulating visit inserts with automatic customer/entity creation
